title: Fix production /admin route black screen and ensure Admin Dashboard loads

requirements.text: Fix production deep-link routing so visiting https://vpn-time-unlock.caffeine.xyz/admin loads the React SPA and renders the Admin Panel (instead of a black screen saying “Publish or restore your app”). Implement a static hosting-safe solution that does not rely on server rewrites (e.g., provide an /admin entry HTML that bootstraps the same app).

quotes: when I open vpn-time-unlock.caffeine.xyz/admin, it still shows a black screen saying 'Publish or restore your app'. The Admin Dashboard is not loading. Please fix the Admin Panel UI immediately

acceptanceCriteria: Opening https://vpn-time-unlock.caffeine.xyz/admin in a fresh browser session loads the app UI (no platform placeholder/black screen).
Refreshing the page while on /admin continues to load the app and shows the Admin Panel route (not a 404/placeholder).
Navigation to /admin via the in-app button still works (History API navigation remains functional).

requirements.text: Ensure the Admin Panel dashboard UI renders and exposes the two requested sections for authenticated admins: (1) AdMob Settings (App ID + Rewarded Ad Unit ID with save) and (2) User Stats (users & sessions overview table). Add a clear in-UI error state if any of the admin queries fail so the page never appears as a blank/black screen.

quotes: so I can see the AdMob settings and User Stats

acceptanceCriteria: When logged in as an admin, the Admin Panel page visibly shows an “AdMob Settings” section with the two inputs and a working Save action.
When logged in as an admin, the Admin Panel page visibly shows a “Users & Sessions Overview” section with a table (or an explicit empty-state message when there is no data).
If admin status/overview/AdMob config queries error, the Admin Panel shows a readable error message in the page (not a blank screen), including a retry affordance (button or reload guidance).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not modify immutable hook files listed in the SYSTEM_CONTEXT (implement fixes in other frontend files such as pages/components/assets).
nonGoals: Implementing real Google AdMob SDK integration (native mobile) beyond storing/displaying IDs.
Adding new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Adding real-time updates (websockets) for user stats.
